description:
What this does. Open an employee and use Clinic › Register to Cova. This tells the clinic the person is covered, so they can walk in and be treated.

You can sign up a whole group at once from the employee list.

If someone was signed off before and has come back, registering them again simply switches them back on. There is nothing special to do for a rehire.
name: Register an Employee to Cova
title: Sign an employee up with the clinic
